chatgptBridge.title: ChatGPT Bridge
chatgptBridge.subtitle: Let ChatGPT read shared folders via OpenAI's official tunnel
chatgptBridge.overviewDesc: Share selected folders with ChatGPT. It can find files and read text, but cannot change files through this connection.
chatgptBridge.helpSetup: Choose folders, enter your connection ID and runtime key, then add the connection in ChatGPT. The connection component is included in Wisp; no Terminal installation is needed.
chatgptBridge.helpScope: Only selected folders are shared. Check them for anything you do not want sent to a conversation.
chatgptBridge.helpPrivacy: Read content is sent to OpenAI and enters the conversation. Turn off Enable bridge to prevent automatic reconnection.
chatgptBridge.desktopOnlyDesc: The browser can only show this overview. Open the desktop app, choose shared folders, and complete the connection setup.
chatgptBridge.enabledDesc: Stays connected while Wisp runs; disconnects when Wisp quits.
chatgptBridge.stopHint: Stops this connection only. Turn off Enable bridge to prevent automatic reconnection.
chatgptBridge.step1Desc: The connection tool connects outward, so you do not need to open a port to the internet. Run in Terminal:
chatgptBridge.clientMissing: Connection component missing. Update or reinstall Wisp.
chatgptBridge.accountNote: Use the ID and runtime key from your OpenAI account. An existing connection can be reused on this computer; two computers online at once need separate IDs.
chatgptBridge.keyPermissions: Create a Restricted key with Tunnels Read and Use permissions only. Do not paste an Admin key. The key must belong to the connection's organization.
chatgptBridge.folderRequired: Choose at least one folder first.
chatgptBridge.connectionCheckNote: Computer online means Wisp is reachable, not that ChatGPT is connected. After adding the plugin, send a test request in ChatGPT.
chatgptBridge.testPrompt: Use my Wisp file connection to list this computer's shared folders, then list the files in the first folder. Do not change any files.
chatgptBridge.step2Desc: Create a tunnel first, then enter its ID here.
chatgptBridge.step3Desc: Create an access key, then enter it here.
chatgptBridge.apiKeyStored: Stored in keychain — type to replace
chatgptBridge.apiKeyNote: The key is stored in the macOS keychain, never in the config file.
chatgptBridge.step4Desc: Only these folders are visible to ChatGPT; sensitive files like .env and private keys are always denied.
chatgptBridge.step5Desc: Open the Plugins page and use the options below. You do not need to recreate a connection you have already added.
chatgptBridge.pluginAuthNote: This Wisp connection does not require OAuth. Leave the client ID and client secret empty. Enter the runtime key from step 2 only in Wisp.
chatgptBridge.pluginEntryMissing: If Create is unavailable, check your workspace permissions and Developer mode in settings.
chatgptBridge.privacyNote: Note: content ChatGPT reads is sent to OpenAI and enters the conversation context. Keep secrets out of shared folders. Read-only ≠ private.
chatgptBridge.loadError: Check that the desktop app is running, then try again.
